subject: Psychology
central_question: How does stress arise from the interaction between people and life demands, and how can coping, life skills and positive health reduce its harmful effects?
in_scope_units: Positive health, life skills and resilience

known_pitfalls.correction: Eustress can energise performance, while distress occurs when demands overwhelm coping.

known_pitfalls.claim: The same event creates equal stress in everyone.
known_pitfalls.correction: Appraisal, experience, control, health, culture and resources make the response individual.

recommended_example_progression: Opening case of Raj: classify stress effects.
NCERT Review Questions 6–8: connect life skills, health and immunity.
ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: The end-of-chapter Review Questions contain Questions 1–12, followed by two Project Ideas.
